title: Kestrel and the Ghost
author: O. M. Eastwick
blurb: Kestrel Sterling, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
